name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.landing.multiple.SpeechVoiceMultipleExternalGuideActivity
description: When an ad offer provides a swipe guide, the Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK opens this page after the user swipes up. It plays a configured video or animation that shows the return gesture and explains how to continue the task.
disableEffect: Blocking it removes the configured swipe-back guide, interrupting ad tasks that use this return flow; rewards for those tasks will no longer be granted.
